task: Identify and locate legal BGM used in the Douyin reference 战术拆解：绿茵场上的空间阅读者

tool.name: douyin-bgm-extract
tool.description: 抖音视频 BGM 提取与识别 Skill：抓原始音轨、三轨分离量化、Shazam 曲名识别、定位正版音源
tool.how_used: Read docs via cursor-github only (no clone). Local 171s AAC already present, so used the documented local-audio path: ffmpeg copy of the video audio, then official scripts/scan_bgm.py + shazamio (pip --target). mediakit-cli was not installed; 3-stem separation was therefore not run.

source_video.title: 战术拆解：绿茵场上的空间阅读者

identification_method: shazamio Shazam recognize on multiple 6–10s 16kHz mono clips with +8 dB gain, as documented. No human listening. One NO MATCH was never treated as a title. Official iTunes 30s previews were also recognized and waveform-aligned to the mix.

tracks_identified.title: 人生志在一博
tracks_identified.label: 李富贵
tracks_identified.in_video: Consistently identified from the opening through ~144–146s (windows at 0,10,25,35,50,60,70,88,95,110,120,138,140,141,144s). Isolated NO MATCH at 76–82s are between same-track hits and are not a second title. Switch/overlap around 145–147s.
tracks_identified.loop_evidence: Shazam official offsets: video 8s→official 8.007s, video 50s→official 50.007s, video 120s→official 8.171s. Preview-to-mix NCC also peaks at 0.314s and again at 112.147s (interval 111.833s). Loop restarts ~1.12s earlier than the 112.953s catalog duration; treat as approximate, not sample-accurate, because the full official file was not obtained.
tracks_identified.same_work_confirmation: Official 30s iTunes preview also identified as the same Shazam id 905406860.
tracks_identified.not_the_same_as: Not a separated residual from the Douyin file, and not a lossless master.
tracks_identified.catalog_notes: iTunes Search country=CN returned 0; US/GB catalog has the track. NetEase search hit the same title/artist/album and the same 112953 ms duration; fee=8 so no free download was attempted. Deezer search returned 0. 剪映曲库 was not opened in this run.

tracks_identified.title: passion
tracks_identified.label: Goost Music
tracks_identified.in_video: Identified from 147s through the end (windows at 147,149,151,152,158,163,165s). 144s window still matches the first song; 145s was NO MATCH (transition).
tracks_identified.version: Original 'passion', not 'passion (Speed Up)' ISRC DGA0P2461648 / 126149 ms, and not 'passion (Slowed)' / 156851 ms.
tracks_identified.approx_official_section: Shazam offsets: video 158s→official 25.339s, video 165s→official 32.158s. Extrapolated, video ~147–171s ≈ official ~14–38s. timeskew/frequencyskew ≈ -0.024, larger than the main track, so this section cue is approximate. Official 30s preview did not strongly cross-correlate with the ending (NCC < 0.08); Apple's preview is likely a different excerpt.
tracks_identified.catalog_notes: Beatport is a paid store and was not used. NetEase has the original and the Speed Up/Slowed variants; use only the original 132466 ms / id 2635437250.

confidence.main_bed: High: 15+ independent windows across 3 passes plus the official preview, all the same Shazam id / ISRC. Offsets are mutually consistent with a near-start sync and one loop.
confidence.ending: High that the work is the original 'passion'; medium for the exact in-song entry point because of larger skew and failed preview alignment.
confidence.numeric_shazam_confidence: shazamio did not return a usable percent score; location.accuracy was 0.01 on dumps and was not treated as a confidence percentage.

mixed_source_extract.quality: Direct copy of the Douyin video audio: HE-AACv2 44.1 kHz stereo ~60.7 kbps (m4a 1,315,828 bytes). WAV is a 16-bit 44.1 kHz PCM decode, not a higher-quality source.
mixed_source_extract.legal_note: Contains commentary mixed with music. This is a separation residual / mixed extract, NOT an official lossless master, and is not a production-ready clean BGM.

official_previews_only.source: Public iTunes/Apple official 30-second preview, not the full song.
Public iTunes/Apple official 30-second preview of the original version, not the full song.

full_official_masters.reason: No license purchase, paid download, or login/paywall bypass was performed. No free full-length official file was available on the paths used (CN iTunes empty, NetEase fee=8, Audiomack/UnitedMasters/Apple/Spotify are stream or store pages).

cues.notes: Cues combine Shazam offsets, preview-to-mix NCC, and the existing reference content map board times. Not from listening.

items.advice: Start the official track at its beginning (video is synced near official 0). Keep the bed under the hook; do not wait for the first board.

items.advice: Continuous bed under boards and live verification, ducked under VO. 76–82s Shazam misses are not a song change. Loop once around video 111.83s / 112.15s; the catalog duration is 112.953s, so verify the loop point after the full official file is in hand.
